sentences.en: It goes without saying that he is a superb pianist.
sentences.zh: 他当然是一位极好的钢琴家。

sentences.en: That museum has a superb collection of Celtic era cultural artifacts.
sentences.zh: 那座博物馆收藏了大量凯尔特时代的文化珍品，质量极高。

sentences.en: Our tour guide speaks perfect Berber and his accent is superb.
sentences.zh: 我们的导游讲一口完美的柏柏尔语，发音也很棒。
